about.title: About Good Friend Mission Church
about.lead: We worship in love and hope to be good friends in one another's lives.
about.h3:
A community that becomes
one family in Jesus Christ
about.p1: Good Friend Mission Church is a community of faith that treasures God's Word and worship, and loves one another.
about.p2: We gather for Sunday morning worship, the Cambodian, Vietnamese and Filipino communities, and Korean language classes.
about.denom: Presbyterian Church of Korea · GOOD FRIEND MISSION CHURCH
about.quote: “In Christ Jesus we are all beloved brothers and sisters.”
about.quoteSrc: From “Our Hope” in the church bulletin
worship.title: Worship Times
worship.lead: We come together in the Word, in prayer, and in the worship and learning of our communities.
worship.note: Based on the bulletin of October 18, 2026. Please check with the church for any changes before visiting.
hope.title: Our Hope
hope.lead: The prayers and hopes of our church, as printed in the bulletin.
hope.1: May we be a church that God loves.
hope.2: May we be believers who bring joy to Jesus.
hope.3: We pray for a life walked with the Holy Spirit.
hope.4: May I read the Word for myself and meditate on the Lord.
hope.5: Let us serve our families with joy.
hope.6: We hope to be good friends to our neighbors.
hope.7: Make us mirrors that reflect the Lord's light into dark places.
hope.8: We pray with hope for our nation and people.
hope.9: We share the gospel, in season and out of season.
hope.10: May we be a church that prepares for the Lord's coming.
hope.closing: In Christ Jesus we are all beloved brothers and sisters.
